title: Delivered Plans are set aside and frozen

steps.action: Deliver with a Task open and no Review, then with an unmerged Review, then with all done and merged.
steps.expected_result: The first two are refused with their reasons, and only the last delivers.

steps.action: Open the Plans section with a delivered Plan, with and without the filter.
steps.expected_result: It is hidden by default and shown by the filter.

steps.action: Run plan list, and plan list --all.
steps.expected_result: It is left out and counted, then included.

steps.action: Open a delivered Plan, then try each kind of edit.
steps.expected_result: The page opens and says so, and every edit is refused.

expected_result: Each step behaves as its acceptance criterion says.
